# Pi RPC 0.80.10 To 0.83.0 Compatibility Corpus

Frozen package and selected-source evidence for every stable
`@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` point from `0.80.10` through `0.83.0`.

The corpus classifies direct-bash and persisted-session changes without adding
either operation to Swallowtail. It contains no provider response, credential,
prompt, or host path.

Sources:

- https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/releases/tag/v0.83.0
- https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v0.83.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/rpc.md
- npm registry metadata for the six exact package versions
